question: Is the PLS(25) multitask advantage over per-gene ridge robust to the choice of ridge comparator and to resampling over folds?
data: results/p2_multitask.json folds (10 LOPO folds): pls_median_r, ridge_m1_committed, ridge_m1_refold. No new model fits.
analysis: delta_c = pls - ridge_m1_committed; delta_r = pls - ridge_m1_refold (per fold)
exact one-sided sign test (H0 P(delta>0)=0.5) for each
paired bootstrap over folds (10000 resamples, seed 20261008) 95% percentile CI of the median delta for each
gate: SURVIVES if for BOTH comparators: wins in >=9/10 folds AND bootstrap CI lower bound of median delta > 0. Otherwise FAILS and is reported as such.
limits_declared: 10 folds = 10 patients; same cohort, no independent data; fold medians not gene-level; bootstrap over 10 folds is coarse; sign test p floor is 2^-10=0.00098 one-sided.
not_done: No outcome has been computed at the time of this file.
